thread:
maya: quick sync on the new open model onboarding — need owners & blockers for catalog launch tomorrow. model name: beryl-6.1b (community checkpoint).

sam: tagging in. i grabbed the model artifacts yesterday. basic ingest script ran but license header looks ambiguous — @li can you confirm if the repo-level NOTICE + non-commercial clause blocks catalog listing?

li: saw the link, will review. quick note: repository has mixed licenses (Apache-2.0 for code, CC-BY-NC for weights). that NC is a blocker for hosted downloads; might be okay for private/dedicated with explicit warning. filing short note in legal tracker. ETA end of day.

rhea: from perf side i ran local throughput tests on a single A10G. baseline with fp16: p50=63ms, p95=190ms for 128 tokens; tokens/sec ~420. with 4-bit quant we get p50=95ms, p95=250ms but cost down ~2.6x. quality delta looks small on our eval set (ROUGE down ~0.6). attaching quick eval summary.

jorge: runtime work: need quant profiles in the model bundle and a small adapter to map kv-cache dims (this model uses nonstandard attn heads). i'm blocked on a CR — opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1428. pinging reviewers @maya @sam for a quick look. if we get that merged we can push canary tomorrow.

sam: noted. i've started metadata for catalog entry; missing fields: "allowed_deploy_modes" (blocked if NC), "recommended_quant_profiles" (rhea, can you paste the profile names?), and perf tags.

rhea: recommended profiles: ["fp16-default", "q4_0-aggressive", "q8_1-safe"] — i'll add numeric perf/quality rows to the staging entry in the registry.

model-registry-bot: Ingest job started for beryl-6.1b at 1802468345. Status: artifacts validated; metadata incomplete (missing license_clearance).

maya: ok — plan: 1) @li finish license note (EOD) — if NC we mark catalog as "private-only" and surface warning. 2) @jorge prioritize that CR, we need runtime mapping. 3) @rhea finish perf table and attach eval prompts. 4) @sam prep rollout plan and canary route config. If any of these cannot be done by EOD please shout.

li: quick update — I can approve metadata for listing as "dedicated/private only" with a clear NC label, but cannot approve hosted distribution. will add legal tag "NC-weights" to the registry entry.

jorge: PR updated with kv-cache mapping and a small test; CI flaky but passing locally. request reviews from infra/serving leads. if we get signoff in next 2 hours i can cut the canary image.

sam: i started a small canary policy draft: route to dedicated pool 3, max qps 150, fallback to orca-mini-7b if latency >300ms. putting it in the console as a draft.

rhea: uploaded perf table to the registry staging entry (see notes). added eval set: conv-summ, code-gen-smoke, longform-coherence. quality deltas look acceptable for q4_0 on conv-summ but drop in code-gen, so recommend q8_1 for code workloads.

maya: thanks — two small asks: (1) @sam please add the legal tag and allowed_deploy_modes to the metadata before the canary. (2) @jorge add a health check that fails fast if kv-cache mismatch detected (so we don't corrupt live requests).

sam: will do. adding: {"allowed_deploy_modes": ["dedicated","private"], "legal_tags": ["NC-weights"]} to staging entry now.

model-registry-bot: Metadata updated at 1802468599 by sam. Current status: ingest awaiting runtime canary.

maya: final checkpoint — if runtime canary and perf spot checks pass, we will schedule a limited catalog publish for dedicated/private tomorrow morning and inform sales/support. otherwise we hold. any last blockers?

li: none from legal after the tagging.

jorge: placing a small note on the PR about health check. aiming for canary image by 1802468720.

sam: i'll draft the customer-facing note after canary passes. cc: marketing on the announcement thread.

maya: awesome — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

rhea: quick follow-up: i recommend adding an automated regression test to the eval pipeline for code-gen prompts to avoid silent drops when we switch quant profiles. filing ticket now.

maya: great idea — please assign to eng-ml-evals.

rhea: done: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENGML-1123-add-codegen-regression-for-beryl

model-registry-bot: Canary image pushed at 1802468720 by jorge. Status: canary-deployed to dedicated pool 3 — monitoring active.
